name: Arrow Wipe
description: A notched arrowhead window onto the second clip flies in from the edge behind it (or appears at the center), then swells until it fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the arrow points and flies toward (x right, y up)

params.name: notch
params.description: Depth of the notch at the back of the arrowhead (0 for a plain triangle)

params.name: width
params.description: Opening angle of the arrowhead's tip, in degrees

params.name: count
params.description: Number of nested chevrons flying in a row

params.name: origin
params.description: Grow the arrow from the center of the frame instead of flying it in
